title: Student Privacy & Campus Surveillance Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free template to request information about campus surveillance and protect your student privacy rights under FERPA and educational privacy laws.
description: A comprehensive letter template for students and parents to formally request information about campus surveillance systems, data collection practices, and privacy policies from educational institutions.

sections.heading: Subject Line and Opening
sections.content:
Subject: Request for Information Regarding Student Privacy and Campus Surveillance Systems

Dear [School Official's Name],

I am writing to formally request information about the surveillance systems, monitoring practices, and data collection policies currently in place at [School Name]. As a [student/parent of a student], I am exercising my rights under the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA) and state privacy laws to understand how my [personal data/child's educational records] are being collected, stored, and used.

sections.heading: Specific Information Requests
sections.content:
I respectfully request the following information:

1. A complete list of all surveillance cameras, monitoring devices, and digital tracking systems currently installed on campus
2. Detailed information about any proctoring software used for online exams, including data collection practices
3. Policies regarding monitoring of school-issued devices (laptops, tablets, etc.)
4. Information about third-party educational technology vendors with access to student data
5. Data retention policies and procedures for deleting surveillance footage and digital records
6. Opt-out procedures for non-essential monitoring or data collection systems

sections.heading: Legal Rights Reference
sections.content:
This request is made pursuant to:

• The Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA) - 20 U.S.C. § 1232g
• [State Privacy Laws applicable in your jurisdiction]
• The school's published privacy policy and student handbook

I understand that under FERPA, educational institutions must provide parents and eligible students with access to educational records and information about data collection practices within 45 days of a written request.

sections.heading: Specific Concerns
sections.content:
I have particular concerns about:

• The extent of monitoring through school-issued devices when used at home
• Data sharing agreements with third-party educational technology companies
• Storage and security of biometric data (if collected)
• Remote proctoring software that may access personal files or monitor home environments
• Whether surveillance data is shared with law enforcement or other external parties

I would appreciate clarification on these matters to ensure my privacy rights are being respected.

sections.heading: Response Timeline and Format
sections.content:
I would appreciate a written response within 30 days of receipt of this letter. Please provide the requested information in electronic format if possible. If any of the requested information cannot be provided, please specify the legal basis for withholding such information.

If you need to schedule a meeting to discuss these matters in person, I am available at your convenience. Please contact me at [your phone number] or [your email address] to arrange a suitable time.

sections.heading: Closing
sections.content:
Thank you for your attention to this important matter. I look forward to your prompt response and to working together to ensure student privacy rights are protected at [School Name].

For additional privacy protection while researching these issues online, I recommend using privacy-focused browsers like a privacy-focused browser to prevent tracking of your educational privacy research.

Sincerely,

[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]
[Student ID Number (if applicable)]
